title: Child welcome
hero: Welcome to Alarka, the transparent child companion
ui: Install disclosure; what it does; setup is not hidden
api: Local onboarding state; no sensors until legal and OS grants
rule: Age-appropriate transparency and identifiable app entry
error: Guardian unverified; unsupported Android; offline
accept: Accessible monitoring information always available.

title: Child transparency disclosure
ui: Authorized adults; live location; history/usage off; data purpose
api: Signed family grant summary and consent-purpose registry
rule: Child may inspect monitoring and OS permissions regardless of subscription
error: Policy unavailable; withdrawn guardian; offline
accept: No hidden monitoring scope and last verified snapshot indicated.

title: Enter pairing code
hero: Pair Alarka with the verified Madalasa guardian
ui: Code entry; QR optional; single-use notice; expiry countdown
api: POST /enrollment code, P-256 public key SPKI
rule: Code consumed one time; only hashed server storage
error: Invalid code; expired; attempted brute force
accept: Rejected code cannot create active device.

title: Keystore proof in progress
hero: Prove this is the linked device
ui: Public key fingerprint; challenge timer; verified status
api: POST /enrollment/{enrollmentId}/proof signed nonce
rule: Hardware-backed/nonexportable private key remains on child phone
error: Wrong nonce; lost key; timeout; replay
accept: Only valid signature yields bound device token.

title: Guardian authority review
ui: Parent identity; relationship notice; rights; approval status
api: Parent identity+verified consent/exception record once legally designed
rule: Google OIDC token alone cannot prove guardian authority
error: Dispute; missing adult verification; purpose OFF
accept: No real under-18 telemetry until signed legal gate.

title: Child permission overview
hero: Check each setting on this phone
ui: Location; notifications; battery; usage OFF; managed eligibility
api: CapabilityRegistry / POST /devices/{id}/capabilities
rule: No remote parent-granted Android permissions, show actual OS state
error: UNKNOWN; OS_REJECTED; DENIED
accept: Settings recheck onResume, no assumed success.

title: Location Settings guide
ui: App info > Permissions > Location; precise vs approximate
api: Intent for app permission settings; FusedLocationProvider only if legal
rule: Background collection limited by version, user and Play rules
error: Permission denied; location OFF; background restricted
accept: No GPS collected until all required gates pass.

title: Notification Settings guide
ui: Android notification permission/channel list; test notice
api: POST_NOTIFICATIONS as supported by OS; capability report
rule: App may not force notification allowance or DND bypass
error: Disabled channel; API old; OS_REJECTED
accept: Reported notification status matches device truth.

title: Battery & background guide
ui: Battery restrictions; delayed jobs; Eco explanation
api: OS battery restriction read; vendor settings; WorkManager scheduling
rule: No bypass of Android Doze/background launch restrictions
error: Restricted; OEM kills process; unavailable intent
accept: Timings remain best-effort, status accurate.

title: Usage Access (disabled)
ui: Show reason; no hidden usage table; opt-in review if approved
api: UsageStatsManager path only after Indian counsel/owner approval
rule: OFF for Indian minors by default even with OS grant
error: No consent; missing Usage Access; partial report
accept: No actual usage data collected in initial minor pilot.

title: Managed DPC setup
ui: Device-owner prerequisites; backup/reset warning; lab-only guide
api: DevicePolicyManager.isDeviceOwnerApp; documented factory provisioning
rule: Ordinary installed app cannot become DPC with a tap
error: Not resettable; STANDARD; protected package
accept: Never mark managed without OS device owner confirmation.

title: Monitoring center
ui: Active categories; approved adults; time of last sync; revoke info
api: Scoped server grants and on-device collection flags
rule: Always accessible even if app's setup Activity is closed
error: Offline; pending policy; revoked family
accept: Disclosure correctly reflects actual enabled categories.

title: Child device health
ui: Battery; network; Android API; app version; last sync; key status
api: POST /devices/{deviceId}/health and /capabilities
rule: Heartbeat is not GPS; report as separately timestamped
error: Revoked key; OS permission changed; offline
accept: No false fresh state from stale heartbeat.

title: Encrypted offline queue
ui: Event count; oldest pending age; last ACK; errors
api: Encrypted local durable queue; idempotent event_uuid upload on reconnect
rule: Only delete local events after confirmed DB commit ACK
error: No network; low disk; duplicate; revoked child
accept: No duplicate server record and no fake successful send.

title: Child quick check-in
hero: Let a guardian know you're okay
ui: Visible I'm OK / Need contact; queue and status
api: Child-signed event UUID to durable SOS/check-in ingress
rule: Parent receives only if RECEIVE_CHECKIN grant verified
error: Offline; no recipient; FCM accepted
accept: Human ACK shown separately from server acceptance.

title: SOS status and manual call
ui: Queued; server accepted; push provider accepted; guardian ACK
api: High-priority outbox and optional SMS fallback if separately funded
rule: No guarantee of rescue; real independent outage path absent
error: Primary VM down; offline; SMS vendor missing
accept: Visible honest pending state, never fake guardian notified.

title: Access withdrawn
hero: What happens after access is revoked?
ui: Who was removed; current data permission; next sync rights
api: Revocation epoch, device stream invalidation, tombstone reconciliation
rule: Stop new unauthorized sharing and queued retries
error: Old data cached; device offline; revoked token
accept: Server denies revoked principal even across restore.

title: Child settings & appearance
ui: Light/dark/eco future handoff; disclosure; help; permission shortcuts
api: Local DataStore; child capability+policy read
rule: Theme implementation left to developers; visual design one style
error: Preference unavailable; no server; permission denied
accept: Privacy notice available regardless of selected theme.

title: Managed rule status
ui: Scheduled apps; currently suspended packages; next transition; undo
api: DPC command receipt/DevicePolicyManager status if eligible
rule: Protected and essential packages never suspended
error: OS_REJECTED; stale policy; STANDARD
accept: UI reports actual OS outcome, not requested command status.

title: Optional media capture request
hero: No hidden camera or microphone access
ui: Feature unavailable notice; OS/version support; visible permission flow if approved
api: No M1 endpoint; conditional child-initiated capture API research
rule: Background OS limits persist after grant; cannot pretend stealth capture
error: Denied; not foreground; privacy indicator
accept: Default DISABLED, no automatic hidden recording.

title: Secure re-enrollment
hero: Replace lost or revoked device identity
ui: Old key invalid; new pairing; parent owner approval; instructions
api: POST /enrollment and challenge/proof for fresh key
rule: Do not resurrect old revoked credentials or grants
error: Key lost; child moved families; replay code
accept: New credential created only after verified new owner pairing.
